name: Carol Raines Brown
office: West Basin Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 2

items.text: Carol Raines-Brown is a former Inglewood Unified School District board member and a community outreach organizer for the Los Angeles Unified School District. She says she would protect affordable water, strengthen conservation, expand environmental education, and ensure every community has a voice. She voted against the Inglewood Unified School District entering state receivership.
